findings.message: The 'world' chart is a PowerPoint extension (chartex) chart that PowerPoint has not yet accepted natively from this exporter (pass chartex: 'native' to write its chartex part); its data is exported as a native clustered column chart instead.

Horizontal bars and singleton categories use explicit full-plot line/text overlays. These editable shapes do not follow independent chart moves or data/axis edits; edited or uncertain bindings import as visible ordinary shapes.

PowerPoint's native categorical Pareto aggregation can omit negative categories. Every numeric category is exported in descending order as editable signed columns with an explicit positive-only cumulative-share line on a secondary 0–1 axis. The cumulative values are static: native bar edits do not recalculate them. Import returns this combo and its sorted/derived data, not the original Pareto data form.

The 'pareto' chart is drawn as core's pareto-as-columns fallback: a Pareto chart sorts one series, so its several series are exported as a clustered column chart of every series in data order, as the preview draws it.
